sloka: सप्त रात्रे कृत आहारा वायुना अचल वासिनः ।दिवम् वर्ष शतैः याताः सप्तभिः सकलेवराः ॥४-१३-१९॥
transliteration: sapta rātre kṛta āhārā vāyunā acala vāsinaḥ ।divam varṣa śataiḥ yātāḥ saptabhiḥ sakalevarāḥ ॥4-13-19॥

translations.english: 'These seven sages used to live on air and that too once in seven nights. They lived for seven hundred years performing penance with motionlessness and attained heaven along with their bodies.
